description.narrative: Under Phase 1, P4I established its credentials for improving partner government decision-making on infrastructure development, particularly the enabling environment for infrastructure investment. P4I led Australia’s engagement on Southeast Asia’s energy transition; improved partners’ infrastructure financing strategies; initiated support in the telecommunications sector; helped accelerate the development of transport infrastructure projects; and leveraged expertise from Australian organisations. Phase 2 will contribute to three End-of-Program Outcomes: Improved enabling environments supporting the delivery of quality infrastructure Development, financing and implementation of quality infrastructure projects, Strengthened relationships between Australia and Southeast Asian partners through infrastructure cooperation and partnerships. Phase 2 incorporates dedicated intermediate outcomes on gender equality, disability and social inclusion (GEDSI), climate change and disaster resilience.
